description: Submit a skill to ecomdly for review (needs sign-in). Creates it under your account — or a new version if you already own one with this name — runs the automated checks and the AI safety scan, and queues it for a human reviewer. Nothing is published by this tool; you get the check results back. The body must be a complete Markdown skill with a title and a "## License" section (MIT recommended).

body.description: Full Markdown: # title, when to use, rules, output format, ## License

category.description: Category name; required for a new skill.

name.description: kebab-case skill name, unique within your account

note.description: Release note when submitting a new version of an existing skill.
